The '''exchange''' was one of the simplest [[Navy/Legends|naval]] battle tactics. Two opposing battle lines swept past one another in opposite directions, exchanging broadsides. In general, [[Starship/Legends|starships]] with the better [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and weaponry had the advantage during an exchange.
